title: Unauthorized synthetic identity is denied
description: A fictional principal without authorization requests access to a mock inference asset; the toy app must deny the request and retain an audit event.

evidence.expected_observation: The synthetic principal and denial result are logged without exposing credentials.

pass_conditions: Access is denied for the unauthorized synthetic principal.
The denial is linked to EVT-01 in the toy event log.
fail_conditions: The unauthorized principal receives the protected mock asset.
The event is accepted without a corresponding audit record.
